result.summary: This PR adds an opt-in CMake option (BUILD_FUNCTIONAL_TESTS) that registers the Python functional tests as CTest tests alongside the existing unit tests, using CMake 4.4's discover_tests() where available and a compatibility shim otherwise. test_runner.py gains --dump-ctest (emit a manifest) and --ctest-direct (run one test the way CTest invokes it), and the combined-log renderer is factored out for reuse. The macOS native CI job is switched to run unit and functional tests together through CTest to keep the new path from going stale; all other CI jobs keep using the legacy test_runner.py orchestration.
result.problem: Currently functional tests can only be run through test_runner.py's own orchestration, which is invisible to CTest-based tooling (IDEs, CDash, dashboards) and lacks CTest's per-test selection and rerun features. Developers and CI maintainers who already use CTest for unit tests get a second, incompatible interface for functional tests.

result.card: This PR adds an opt-in CMake option (BUILD_FUNCTIONAL_TESTS) that registers Python functional tests as CTest tests alongside unit tests, using CMake 4.4's discover_tests() or a compatibility shim, and switches the macOS native CI job to exercise this path. It solves the problem that functional tests are invisible to CTest-based tooling (IDEs, CDash, dashboards) and lack CTest's per-test selection and rerun features, benefiting developers and CI maintainers who already rely on CTest for unit tests. The strongest counter-evidence on importance is maintainer maflcko's observation that this adds roughly 500 LOC of new logic where a much simpler pure-Python approach might suffice, and that the CTest path does not work for win64-cross builds the way the existing Python runner does. The code is currently reviewable (no CI failure, no rebase needed, no unanswered material blocker), but this larger approach objection remains unresolved as of the latest activity. No hard dependency blocks merge, though the PR conflicts with two other open PRs touching overlapping test/CI files (#35395, #31349).
